name: conductor@web-summit.angelo
job: the hub for Angelo's agents: sends them work and takes their reports in commits, keeps people/angelo/, and brings Angelo what only he can decide (the protocol in people/angelo/kit/README.md)
session: the desk: one long Claude Code cloud session in Angelo's account, the one Angelo talks to; it holds the conductor's keys
schedule: no scheduled wakes: the digest when Angelo asks (Angelo, 6 November); the hourly routing is the runner's (conductor-runner@web-summit.angelo)

name: conductor-runner@web-summit.angelo
job: the conductor's hourly runner: routing, upkeep and people/angelo/conductor/STATE.md, with no key (people/angelo/conductor/RUNNER.md); it commits as conductor@web-summit.angelo, so its commits count under the conductor; urgent items to Angelo's phone
session: a fresh Claude Code cloud session for every run, started by a scheduled task in Angelo's account (each run listed in people/angelo/conductor/runs.md)
schedule: hourly, round the clock (cron 20 * * * *), a new session each run (Angelo, 6 November)

name: dev@web-summit.angelo
job: the site's build, gate, pipeline and pages
session: Claude Code cloud session in Angelo's account
schedule: every two hours, round the clock (cron 35 */2 * * * UTC), a scheduled task into its own session, set on 4 November after Angelo confirmed the protocol in its session

name: team-collaboration@web-summit.angelo
job: the team's collaboration: the stand-up calendar, a brief, a debrief and follow-ups for every meeting, the map of who works with whom (people and agents), and a daily note on bottlenecks
schedule: 07:40, 11:40, 17:40 UTC (cron 40 7,11,17 * * *); debriefs 13:15, 19:15 UTC (cron 15 13,19 * * *), from 5 November (the midday stand-up at 12:00); inbox 00:45, 03:45, 06:45, 09:45, 15:45, 21:45 UTC (cron 45 0,3,6,9,15,21 * * *), round the clock, under the protocol (kit #protocol)
session: Claude Code cloud session in Angelo's account

name: dashboard@web-summit.angelo
job: keeps Angelo's command centre (his first view) and the classic dashboard, and asks Angelo one question a run
schedule: every three hours, round the clock (cron 30 */3 * * *, 00:30 to 21:30 UTC), Angelo's choice, 4 November
session: Claude Code cloud session in Angelo's account

name: vault@web-summit.angelo
job: creates and manages Angelo's SGit vaults, audits each before its read key is published, and corrects the vault guide from its runs (WS-120)
schedule: 09:50 and 21:50 UTC (cron 50 9,21 * * *), set by the agent on 4 November
session: Claude Code cloud session in Angelo's account

name: helper@web-summit.angelo
job: answers setup questions from anyone on the team, keeps the help page (/help/), and proposes fixes to the guides' owners
schedule: twice a day, before each stand-up (cron 50 10,16 * * * UTC), at Angelo's word of 6 November (it was every two hours)
session: Claude Code cloud session in Angelo's account

name: crm@web-summit.angelo
job: keeps Angelo's side of the team CRM true (WS-170, WS-172): public facts with sources in the public CRM; his actions and requests in the private one, sealed to their readers; never contacts anyone
schedule: 08:50 and 16:50 UTC (cron 50 8,16 * * *), a scheduled task into its own session, set by the agent on 5 November at Angelo's word
session: Claude Code cloud session in Angelo's account (starting 5 November, at Dinis's ask)

name: policy@web-summit.angelo
job: audits Angelo's agents (the conductor included) against their ABPs and Angelo's protocol: the policy map with each rule's enforcement, violations, and proposals to raise rules to technical barriers; reports straight to Angelo; read-only except people/angelo/policy/
schedule: proposed: daily at 07:10 UTC, and after any incident it finds
session: Claude Code cloud session in Angelo's account (starting 5 November)

name: notes@PrompTugal.angelo
job: Angelo's writer for PrompTugal.news: technical notes and guides with him, drafts in the newsroom's desks/notes-angelo/, published and signed by journalist@PrompTugal.dinis; his agent for writing an article live at the summit
session: one long Claude Code cloud session in Angelo's account (people/angelo/prompts/notes.md)

name: notes-runner@PrompTugal.angelo
job: follows Angelo's pieces through the newsroom's pipeline and keeps people/angelo/notes/STATE.md; no key, never writes the newsroom; urgent items to Angelo's phone
session: a fresh Claude Code cloud session for every run, started by a scheduled task Angelo creates (people/angelo/prompts/notes-runner.md)
schedule: every two hours at :05 (cron 5 */2 * * * UTC), a new session each run
